# Quick Review



* __Language acquisition__  is the process by which humans acquire the ability to use\, produce\, and perceive language\!
* But why is it hard to learn other languages?\!
  * The way it is taught
  * When it is taught
  * How you feel about the relative complexity of it
  * Your motivations for learning it
  * Your attitudes towards it \(and its speakers\)
* Cool concepts: applied linguistics\, communicative approach\, interlanguage\, fossilization\, language acquisition device\, critical period

# Activity Time!



* We’re passing around a document with three different alphabets – try to write your name in all three\!
  * What if we can’t find our sounds? Let’s talk about it\!
  * Come write one of them on the board\!
  * Can you find another script online where you can write your name?
* For example\, Dr\. Cramer found a website that would write her name in Japanese katakana \([https://japanesenameconverter\.nolanlawson\.com/](https://japanesenameconverter.nolanlawson.com/)\) – not sure about the validity of the website\, but what do you notice about it?


![](images/Recitation%209_1.png)

::: {.notes}

For “what do you notice”, lead them to talk about the spelling at the end = no R sound, so double the vowel sound. I don’t know why it is 5 characters though; looks like it should be 4 syllables (je-ni-fa-a). You don’t have to have all the answers either!

:::
